text:
Maria G.: Hey ops — planning a small blue->green weight shift tonight 23:15 UTC for router `rtr-main` to route traffic to service v3.2.1. Target window ~30m. Need owners, pin list, and rollback criteria. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Scheduled job `weight-shift/1718209999` created. Initial target weights: blue=95, green=5, ramp step=5% every 3m. Canary window enabled.

Jim O.: I'll handle session-affinity toggle and cookie pinning. Will turn off affinity for the first 15m.

Nina K.: Please note dedicated GPU pools in eu-west are running a maintenance snapshot at 02:00 UTC — keep EU capacity pinned to blue unless we see stable metrics. @Maria G. can you scope region routing?

Maria G.: Good catch. Plan: EU will start at blue=100 -> green=0 for initial 6m probe, then fan out to global ramp if stable. US/CA will follow the 5% ramp.

Alex T.: Ops checklist: ensure canary logging + traces enabled, release notes updated (v3.2.1: quantization fix + KV cache bug). I pushed short notes to the release channel.

Jim O.: Rollback triggers proposed: p95 latency increase > 150ms above baseline sustained for 5m OR error rate spike > 2% for 3m. Also abort on request timeouts > 0.5% for 5m. Agree?

Nina K.: Agree on latency and errors. Add: model output regression alert — QA will run the fixed prompt set after 10m of green at 20% traffic; if quality score drops > 4 points, we pull back.

Maria G.: Perfect. Add a soft-fallback route to v3.2.0 (warm) if we see early instability. We'll keep a 15min grace standby for rollback.

deploy-bot: weight-shift job `weight-shift/1718209999` will execute at 23:15 UTC. Notifying on #incidents if any step fails.

Alex T.: Quick config snippet for ops runbook (pasted):
```
# ramp config
initial: {blue:95, green:5}
step: 5
interval: 180s
eu_override: {start:100->0 at 6m}
rollback: p95>+150ms(5m) || errors>2%(3m) || qa_drop>4pts
```

Maria G.: I'll be on call for the window and will post updates. @Jim O. @Nina K. @Alex T. please ack and keep phones nearby. :white_check_mark:

Jim O.: Ack. I'll flip affinity and monitor p95.

Nina K.: Ack. I'll watch EU pools and capacity pinning.

Alex T.: Ack. I'll run QA prompts at the 10m mark and watch traces.

Maria G.: Closing notes: update release notes with the fallback plan and pin v3.2.1 in the router config after stable shift. See you in the window. :rocket:
